cap_PqMijnWerkIndelen.text:
Capabilities: work-layout, work-filter-priority-pipeline, work-quick-create, work-upcoming-meetings, work-auto-refresh, my-work-roadmap, realtime-updates-ui.
Wat je ziet: My work narrowed to urgent items in one pipeline, with create buttons, the live update banner, the client meetings of this week and the panel to arrange the page.

cap_PqProject.text:
Capabilities: work-project-portfolio, project-portfolio.
Wat je ziet: One project above its cases: plan, progress by estimate points, effort read from humaniq, tasks in the current cycle, closed cycles with their snapshot, linked work in dossiq and other apps, the team and the history.

cap_PqKassaAfrekenen.text:
Capabilities: loyalty-redeem, loyalty-giftcard, pos-transaction-core.
Wat je ziet: The checkout dialog over the till: part of the bill paid with loyalty points, part with a gift card whose balance and validity show, the rest by card, plus selling a new gift card.

cap_PqOrganisatiesVerrijken.text:
Capabilities: clients-bulk-enrichment, clients-registry-numbers-and-enrichment.
Wat je ziet: Five selected organisations get their empty fields filled from the KvK and OpenCorporates in one go; every proposal shows what is there now, what was found and where it came from, and a difference is only applied when ticked.

cap_PqEvenement.text:
Capabilities: mkt-events, marketing-events.
Wat je ziet: One event inside a campaign: places, waiting list and where sign-ups came from, the registrations with their status, the portaliq sign-up form that feeds them, the venue and the history.

cap_PqWebchat.text:
Capabilities: chat-on-website, cm-chatbot, req-multi-municipality, requests-web-chat-and-bot, requests-municipality-per-contact.
Wat je ziet: The web chat desk: chats waiting per municipality, a conversation the bot answered from the knowledge base and handed to a colleague when it got stuck, and who the visitor is with the municipality the chat came from.

cap_PqBeheerPortaal.text:
Capabilities: portal-multi-tenant, portal-audit, portal-contribution, customer-portal.
Wat je ziet: The administrator runs three branded portals from one install, each with its own domain, colour, logo and tabs, and reads the log of every action portal users took.

cap_PqVerbindingscontrole.text:
Capabilities: plat-connection-audit, marketing-search-intelligence.
Wat je ziet: The connection audit: for every social handle stored on a client, whether we follow them and they follow us on Mastodon and Bluesky, and why networks without a follower API cannot be checked.

cap_PqBriefOpstellen.text:
Capabilities: work-letter-template, work-letter-from-filinq-template.
Wat je ziet: Over the resident page, a dialog makes a letter from a filinq template about an open ticket: the preview with salutation, address, reference and appointment filled in, and the choice to print or send it; the letter is filed as an outgoing contact moment.
